observation: Extensionless relative imports still chose one candidate lexically when multiple direct extension-bearing files were equally plausible, so repository ordering rules could fabricate a dependency edge not justified by the observed code.
pre_fix_reproduction: src/main.ts importing ./foo with both src/foo.js and src/foo.ts produced an imports edge to src/foo.js even though this heuristic does not model the project's runtime or compiler extension-priority rules.
change: Keep the existing exact/direct/index ranking, but require the best rank to have exactly one candidate. Equal-rank ambiguity now fails closed instead of inventing a dependency edge.
truth_boundary: This improves integrity of the lightweight relative-import heuristic only. Full Node/TypeScript/bundler/package resolution, configured extension priorities, aliases and non-relative imports remain unresolved.
